sentence: It's a piece that really deserves to be heard.
translation: 这是一部真正值得一听的作品。
analysis: deserve 的双轨考点（语法填空高频）：deserve to be done = deserve doing——“值得被做”两种等值写法（It deserves to be heard. = It deserves hearing.；同族 need/want/require doing 表被动）| that 定语从句修饰 a piece（that 作从句主语）| really 强化推荐语气 | 乐评开篇的“一句话安利”：先给结论再展开——评论文体的先声夺人 | deserve 课堂拓展：deserve punishment / deserve punishing / deserve to be punished 一句三译
pattern: It's a + N + that + really deserves to be + V-ed
imitationCn: 这是一本真正值得反复重读的书。
imitationHint: It's a book that really deserves → to be reread again and again（或 deserves rereading）
imitationAnswer: It's a book that really deserves to be reread again and again.

sentence: The music took me through the twists and turns of a classic story about a young couple torn apart by their families.
translation: 乐曲带我走进一个跌宕起伏的经典故事——一对被家庭拆散的年轻恋人的遭遇。
analysis: took me through 把我带着穿过（音乐作主语的时空动词，呼应 xb1_u1 的 takes us back to）| the twists and turns 跌宕起伏、一波三折（固定名词组：the twists and turns of his career/the story）| torn apart by their families：过去分词短语作后置定语（= who were torn apart...）——tear apart 拆散/使四分五裂（tear-tore-torn；课堂拓展：a war-torn country 饱经战乱的国家、be torn between A and B 左右为难）| 一句话装下梁祝剧情梗概：音乐→故事→冲突三层递进
pattern: S + took me through the twists and turns of + N + about + N + V-ed by ...
imitationCn: 这部纪录片带我走进了一段跌宕起伏的历史——一群被时代洪流冲散又重逢的老友的故事。
imitationHint: The documentary took me through the twists and turns of a history → about old friends separated by the times and reunited at last（过去分词定语）
imitationAnswer: The documentary took me through the twists and turns of a history about old friends separated by the times and reunited at last.

sentence: When the two lovers, Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai, first meet, the music is light and pleasant, as if whispering to the audience.
translation: 当梁山伯与祝英台这对恋人初次相遇时，音乐轻柔愉悦，仿佛在对观众耳语。
analysis: 课件结构分析+仿写题 | the two lovers, Liang Shanbo and Zhu Yingtai：同位语点名 | as if whispering...：as if 引导省略形式的状语从句——从句为“主语+be”结构且主语与主句一致时可省略（= as if it were whispering；课堂例句：He acts as if (he was) a fool.）| whisper to sb 对某人低语（in a whisper 悄声地）| 乐评的“音乐拟人化”笔法：音乐会“耳语”——把听觉感受翻译成人的动作，通感描写的关键技巧 | light and pleasant 双形容词定调
pattern: When + S, 同位语, first meet, S + is + adj., as if + V-ing ...
imitationCn: 当两位演奏者杰克和露西走上舞台时，全场安静下来，仿佛等待已久。
imitationHint: When the two performers, Jack and Lucy, stepped onto the stage, the audience became silent, → as if waiting for a long time（课堂仿写原题）
imitationAnswer: When the two performers, Jack and Lucy, stepped onto the stage, the audience became silent, as if waiting for a long time.

sentence: Angry and sad, Liang falls sick and dies.
translation: 梁山伯悲愤交加，染病而亡。
analysis: 课件专项讲解句：形容词短语 Angry and sad 作状语——说明主语的状态/原因，与句子其他部分用逗号隔开（课堂同族：Now she was back, eager to see her friends. / They waited, breathless, for the result. 他们屏息等待结果）| falls sick 病倒（fall + 形容词表变化：fall ill/asleep/silent）| 六词写尽悲剧转折：形容词前置给情绪、两个动词给结局——极简句式的叙事爆发力 | 与下句 Overcome with sorrow 构成“形容词状语/过去分词状语”姊妹卡
pattern: Adj. and adj., S + falls sick and dies（形容词作状语）
imitationCn: 又累又饿，那个小男孩靠着墙睡着了。
imitationHint: Tired and hungry, → the little boy fell asleep against the wall（形容词短语开头+逗号）
imitationAnswer: Tired and hungry, the little boy fell asleep against the wall.

sentence: Overcome with sorrow, she jumps into his grave.
translation: 她不胜悲恸，纵身跃入他的坟墓。
analysis: 过去分词短语 Overcome with sorrow 作原因状语——她“被悲伤击垮”（被动关系用过去分词，与上句 Angry and sad 形容词状语对照成对）| overcome 课堂三义：①（情绪）压倒、使受不了——be overcome with grief/excitement ②克服——overcome difficulties/fear ③战胜——Sweden overcame France | grave 名词“坟墓”（另作形容词“严重的”：grave concern/danger——一词两性易考）| 一般现在时叙事延续剧情简介语体 | 祝英台殉情的千古一跳，七个词收束
pattern: V-ed + with + 情感N, S + jumps into ...（过去分词作原因状语）
imitationCn: 他被喜悦冲昏了头，抓起奖杯高高举过头顶。
imitationHint: Overcome with joy, → he seized the trophy and raised it high above his head（过去分词开头）
imitationAnswer: Overcome with joy, he seized the trophy and raised it high above his head.

sentence: Finally, during the most exciting part, the music takes a softer turn and ends on a bittersweet note, telling us how the couple transform into butterflies and fly away to be together forever.
translation: 最后，在最激昂的段落中，乐曲转而柔缓，以一个苦乐参半的音符收尾——它告诉我们，这对恋人化作蝴蝶，双双飞去，永不分离。
analysis: 音乐描写的动词链：takes a softer turn 转向柔缓（take a turn 转折）+ ends on a... note 以……的调子结尾（on a positive/sad note 是写作结尾万能搭配！）| bittersweet 复合形容词“苦乐参半的”——化蝶结局的全部况味压进一个词 | telling us... 现在分词作伴随状语，接 how 引导的宾语从句（how the couple transform...）| transform into 蜕变成（比 change 更强调质变；课堂拓展：transform... from... into...）| to be together forever 目的状语收尾 | 乐评结尾句范本：音乐进行时+故事完成时
pattern: Finally, S + takes a + adj. + turn and ends on a + adj. + note, V-ing + how-从句
imitationCn: 最后，在全场的欢呼声中，演出以一个温暖的音符落幕——它告诉我们，普通人的故事也能被唱成传奇。
imitationHint: Finally, amid the cheers of the whole audience, the show ends on a warm note, → telling us how ordinary people's stories can be sung into legends
imitationAnswer: Finally, amid the cheers of the whole audience, the show ends on a warm note, telling us how ordinary people's stories can be sung into legends.

sentence: Most of the songs are about hardship and heartbreak, but also about hope — with plenty of humour thrown in for good measure.
translation: 这些歌大多唱的是艰辛与心碎，但也唱希望——外加许多幽默元素作为馈赠。
analysis: with plenty of humour thrown in：with 复合结构（宾语 + 过去分词 thrown 表被动）——幽默“被额外扔进来”| throw in 附送、额外奉送（熟词僻义：You can have the phone for 4,000 yuan, and I'll throw in the earpiece.）| for good measure 作为额外添头（习语：Use 80g per person and an extra spoonful for good measure.）| hardship and heartbreak 头韵双名词 + but also about hope 转折递进——乡村音乐的情感配方：三分苦、一分甜、附赠笑 | 破折号后补充的轻盈语气
pattern: S + are about A and B, but also about C — with + N + thrown in for good measure
imitationCn: 这些故事大多讲的是奋斗与挫折，但也讲温情——外加不少自嘲式的幽默作为调味。
imitationHint: Most of the stories are about struggle and setbacks, but also about warmth — → with plenty of self-mocking humour thrown in for good measure
imitationAnswer: Most of the stories are about struggle and setbacks, but also about warmth — with plenty of self-mocking humour thrown in for good measure.

sentence: Beethoven, who was almost completely deaf at this point in his life, was unaware of the audience's response until one of the singers turned him around to face the crowd.
translation: 当时贝多芬已近全聋，直到一位歌手扶他转过身面向观众，他才发觉现场反响之热烈。
analysis: 课件结构分析+仿写题 | who 引导非限定性定语从句（双逗号插入）交代关键背景——“几乎全聋”| was unaware of... until...：not/否定含义 + until“直到……才……”（unaware 自带否定义）| turned him around to face the crowd：不定式表目的/结果 | at this point in his life 在人生的这个节点 | 《第九交响曲》首演的传奇一幕：听不见掌声的作曲家——背景从句与 until 主句协力把泪点推到句尾，人物叙事的高光句式
pattern: S, who + was ..., was unaware of + N + until + S + V-ed ...
imitationCn: 史密斯夫妇当时正在吃午饭，直到一阵敲门声响起，他们才知道包裹已经送到了。
imitationHint: The Smiths, who were having lunch, didn't know the arrival of a package → until a knock on the door asked them to open it（课堂仿写原题）
imitationAnswer: The Smiths, who were having lunch, didn't know the arrival of a package until a knock on the door asked them to open it.

sentence: By the time he was a teenager, he had already enjoyed a reputation as a wonderful young musician.
translation: 还是少年时，他就已享有杰出青年音乐家的声誉。
analysis: By the time + 过去时从句，主句用过去完成时 had enjoyed——“到……时已经……”是过去完成时的黄金信号结构（already 再加一码）| enjoy a reputation as 享有……的声誉（enjoy 熟词僻义“享有”；课堂 reputation 网络：earn/win a reputation 赢得声誉、live up to one's reputation 不负盛名、damage/ruin one's reputation 毁掉名声）| a wonderful young musician：形容词双层修饰 | 天才人物介绍的时间刻度句：用年龄反衬成就——传记文的标准配置
pattern: By the time + S + was ..., S + had already enjoyed a reputation as + N
imitationCn: 刚上高二时，她就已享有全校最佳辩手的名声。
imitationHint: By the time she entered Senior Two, she had already enjoyed a reputation as → the best debater in the school（by the time + 过去完成时）
imitationAnswer: By the time she entered Senior Two, she had already enjoyed a reputation as the best debater in the school.

sentence: When composing music at the piano, he would put one end of a pencil in his mouth and place the other end against the instrument so that he could feel the notes.
translation: 在钢琴上作曲时，他会把铅笔的一端含在嘴里，另一端抵住琴身，这样就能感受到音符的震动。
analysis: 课件结构分析+仿写题 | When composing...：时间状语从句的省略（= When he was composing...，主语一致+含 be 时省略主谓）| would + 动词原形表过去反复的习惯（“总会”）| one end... the other end：一端/另一端的对举（two ends 限定范围内用 the other）| against the instrument：against 表“紧贴、抵住”（熟词僻义！非“反对”）| so that + could 目的状语从句 | 失聪者用牙齿听琴——细节即人物：一支铅笔写出贝多芬全部的倔强，读后续写“智慧克服困难”的素材原型
pattern: When + V-ing ..., S + would put + one end ... and place + the other end + against ... so that + S + could + V
imitationCn: 读诗时，伊丽莎白会播放一些背景音乐，这样她就能跟着曲调朗读。
imitationHint: When reading a poem, Elizabeth would play some background music → so that she could read it to the tunes of the music（课堂仿写原题）
imitationAnswer: When reading a poem, Elizabeth would play some background music so that she could read it to the tunes of the music.

sentence: You can soon feel the determination — a quality Beethoven understood well because of his hearing difficulties — coursing through the music.
translation: 很快你就能感受到那种决心——一种贝多芬因听力障碍而深有体会的品质——在乐曲中奔涌。
analysis: 课件结构分析句 | 双破折号插入同位语：a quality (that) Beethoven understood well...——同位语内还嵌着省略关系词的定语从句，插入成分把“决心”的来历讲透再放行 | feel the determination... coursing：感官动词 feel + 宾语 + 现在分词——注意宾补 coursing 被插入语隔开，跨距离的宾补识别是本句最难点 | course 动词“奔流”（熟词僻义！tears coursed down her cheeks；名词义“进程”：the course of history）| 音乐评论的抽象具象化：决心会“奔涌”
pattern: S + can feel + the N — 同位语插入 — V-ing through ...
imitationCn: 你能感受到那股韧劲——一种她在无数次失败中磨出来的品质——贯穿在整场表演中。
imitationHint: You can feel the resilience — a quality she developed through countless failures — → running through the whole performance（破折号插入+宾补分词）
imitationAnswer: You can feel the resilience — a quality she developed through countless failures — running through the whole performance.

sentence: The next two movements are full of desperate lows and uplifting highs which perhaps reflect both his suffering and his strong will to fight it.
translation: 接下来的两个乐章充满绝望的低谷与昂扬的高潮，这或许正映照着他的苦难，以及与苦难抗争的坚强意志。
analysis: desperate lows and uplifting highs：形容词+名词的反义双组对仗（绝望/昂扬、低/高）——lows/highs 形容词名词化作复数名词，乐曲的起伏与人生的起伏同构 | which 定语从句 + perhaps 留有余地的解读（乐评的分寸感：不说死，说“或许”）| both A and B 并列宾语：his suffering（承受）与 his strong will to fight it（反抗）——it 回指 suffering，首尾咬合 | to fight it 不定式后置定语修饰 will | movement 熟词僻义：乐章（非“运动”）
pattern: S + are full of + adj.+N and adj.+N + which + reflect both A and B + to V + it
imitationCn: 这本日记写满了灰暗的低谷和闪光的瞬间，它们或许正映照着她的挣扎，以及她走出挣扎的勇气。
imitationHint: The diary is full of gloomy lows and shining moments → which perhaps reflect both her struggle and her courage to walk out of it
imitationAnswer: The diary is full of gloomy lows and shining moments which perhaps reflect both her struggle and her courage to walk out of it.

sentence: I turned up the volume and stood staring at the radio, holding my breath and waiting for the first notes of the song.
translation: 我调大音量，站在收音机前盯着它，屏住呼吸，等待歌曲的第一个音符。
analysis: 动作三连环的层次：主句双谓语 turned up and stood + stood 后接现在分词 staring（stand doing 保持某姿态做某事）+ 句末又挂两个并列分词 holding... and waiting...——一句话四个动作按“动作→姿态→状态”降速排列，时间仿佛被拉长 | hold one's breath 屏住呼吸（紧张期待的标志动作）| turn up the volume 调大音量（turn up/down 熟词组）| stare at 盯着看 | 读后续写“期待时刻”的顶配句式：外部动作全是静的，内心全是动的
pattern: S + V-ed and stood + V-ing ..., V-ing ... and V-ing ...
imitationCn: 我放下笔，站在公告栏前盯着名单，屏住呼吸，寻找自己的名字。
imitationHint: I put down my pen and stood staring at the notice board, → holding my breath and searching for my own name（stood staring + 双分词）
imitationAnswer: I put down my pen and stood staring at the notice board, holding my breath and searching for my own name.
